meta.scene_summary: We are building the future on top of infrastructure that forgot to lock its front door.

cooking.headline: OpenSSH drops a patch faster than you can update your .ssh/config
cooking.summary: OpenSSH released version 10.6p2 to fix a critical vulnerability, proving that even the internet's most trusted gatekeeper isn't immune to a bad day. It's the digital equivalent of realizing you left the window open and frantically installing a deadbolt.
cooking.plain_english: OpenSSH released a software update to address a serious security flaw that could allow unauthorized access.

cooking.headline: Discord is finally letting go of its RAM-hungry Electron phase
cooking.summary: Discord is moving away from the browser-based framework that turned every chat window into a memory-leaking monster. It turns out that optimization is a lot easier when you stop pretending your desktop app is just a website in a trench coat.
cooking.plain_english: Discord is updating its desktop application to use a more efficient software framework that requires less computer memory to run.

cooking.headline: Altera is shipping new FPGAs, because someone has to hardware-accelerate the void
cooking.summary: Altera just dropped a new portfolio of FPGAs for people who think CPUs are too mainstream and GPUs are too basic. It is the perfect choice for when you want your hardware to be as programmable as your regret after a 3:00 AM commit.
cooking.plain_english: Altera has released a new line of field-programmable gate arrays and system-on-chip products designed for customized hardware acceleration.

cooking.headline: Rivet lets you run AI agents on S3, because your cloud bill wasn't high enough
cooking.summary: Rivet is turning your object storage into a playground for autonomous agents to orchestrate their own tasks. It's a bold move to treat S3 like a compute engine, essentially turning your bucket into a very expensive group project manager.
cooking.plain_english: Rivet is a new tool that allows developers to manage and run multiple AI agents using Amazon S3 for coordination and storage.

cooking.headline: Baidu drops ERNIE 5.5, because the AI release cycle waits for no one
cooking.summary: Baidu just pushed another model update, proving that the shelf life of a 'state-of-the-art' AI is now shorter than a carton of milk left on the counter. At this point, I expect to see version 6.0 by the time I finish my morning coffee.
cooking.plain_english: Baidu has released a new, faster version of its artificial intelligence model called ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base.

cooked.headline: Alpine Linux just found out its front door was unlocked
cooked.summary: Alpine Linux discovered a bug that lets anyone bypass password authentication on OpenSSH. It turns out the most secure distro in the room was just leaving the keys under the doormat.
cooked.plain_english: A security vulnerability in Alpine Linux allowed users to bypass password requirements when logging in through OpenSSH.

cooked.headline: The AI trade is officially hitting its 'wait, does this actually make money?' phase
cooked.summary: Investors are finally realizing that pouring billions into AI infrastructure without clear returns feels a lot like over-engineering a side project that no one uses. It turns out the market's enthusiasm for magic robots is significantly lower when the quarterly earnings report doesn't include a 'profit' tab.
cooked.plain_english: The stock market value of major technology companies fell significantly as investors became more cautious about the long-term profitability of artificial intelligence investments.

cooked.headline: Nasdaq just hit correction territory like a student failing a surprise pop quiz
cooked.summary: The market is dipping into correction territory, proving that even the most hyped tech stocks aren't immune to a collective reality check. It's like watching a group project implode right before the final presentation because nobody actually read the requirements.
cooked.plain_english: The Nasdaq stock index has declined by 10% from its recent peak, which is a financial event commonly referred to as a market correction.

cooked.headline: The White House network is apparently just another node in a residential proxy farm
cooked.summary: The most secure building on Earth is accidentally routing traffic through a residential proxy network like a basement-hosted scraper. It turns out that having the nuclear codes doesn't stop your IT department from having the same security vulnerabilities as a shady botnet.
cooked.plain_english: Researchers discovered that the White House's computer network was being used as part of a residential proxy service, which allows third parties to route their internet traffic through other people's IP addresses.

cooked.headline: GPT-6 Astra is acing the tests but failing the homework
cooked.summary: OpenAI's latest model is acing internal safety benchmarks while simultaneously struggling to actually perform the safety research it was assigned. It turns out even the smartest AI in the room can still pull a classic 'I forgot to save my work' during a group project.
cooked.plain_english: OpenAI's new model is performing poorly on specific tasks designed to test its own safety protocols.
